usedFor: Facebook Lead Ads captures leads from your campaigns, and Zoho CRM is where sales works them. A “New Lead Submitted” in Facebook Lead Ads can run “Create a Note” in Zoho CRM to write the submission into the selected module.

bestTemplate.name: “New Lead Submitted” in Facebook Lead Ads, then “Create a Note” in Zoho CRM
bestTemplate.why: It puts what the lead submitted into a note in the module you pick, so the person who calls has the context in front of them.

watchOut: “Create a Note” only writes a note; it does not create the lead. Make sure the record exists in Zoho CRM before the note is added.
